Aldila Sutjiadi (born 2 May 1995) is an Indonesian professional tennis player who specializes in doubles.
She has career-high rankings of world No. 26 in doubles, achieved on 23 October 2023, and No. 344 in singles, achieved on 24 May 2021. Sutjiadi has won six doubles titles on the WTA Tour and five doubles titles on the WTA Challenger Tour , as well as one singles title and fifteen doubles titles on the ITF Circuit . She is currently the highest-ranked Indonesian tennis player in doubles by the WTA. At the 2018 Asian Games , Sutjiadi and Christopher Rungkat earned Indonesia its first tennis medal in 16 years.
